name: aapadamitra-monorepo
description: AAPADAMITRA — Multi-Hazard Disaster Management & Emergency Coordination Platform

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @aapadamitra/contracts build && pnpm --filter @aapadamitra/api build && pnpm --filter @aapadamitra/web build
scripts.build:api: pnpm --filter @aapadamitra/contracts build && pnpm --filter @aapadamitra/api prisma:generate && pnpm --filter @aapadamitra/api build
